citation.quoted_text: First-lien loan ($ 89,775 par, due 6/2032 ) | amortized cost 88,039 | fair value 88,428

rationale: The raw SOI row for FGI Acquisition shows the investment text as First-lien loan ($ 89,775 par, due 6/2032 ) with amortized cost 88,039 and fair value 88,428. The bundle's extracted holding for the same issuer and row has cost 88,039,000 and fair value 88,428,000, which agree after the filing's thousands scale, but its investment identifier says 89,755 par and omits the dollar marker. The flag is therefore a real localized extraction/format error, not an aggregate cost or fair-value total problem.
